component.name: KYCVerificationWizard
component.business_context: Multi-step Know Your Customer verification process for user identity confirmation

constraints: Supported file types: PDF, JPG, PNG
Verification status options: pending review, approved, rejected

missing_states: loading (initial page load before wizard renders)
submitting (async submission in progress between steps or on final submit)
error (global submission failure or API error)
step-level error (validation failure on personal info fields before advancing)
file upload error (invalid file type or file exceeds 10MB limit)
file upload empty (no file selected yet on document upload step)
file upload success (file accepted and queued)
selfie capture loading (camera initialising or image processing)
selfie capture error (camera permission denied or capture failed)
rejected with reason (rejected status should surface a reason/message)
step disabled (Back button disabled on step 1; Next button disabled until step is valid)
focus-visible (keyboard focus ring on all interactive elements)
accessibility_gaps: Stepper must use role=list with aria-current=step on the active step item to announce progress to screen readers
Wizard region should be wrapped in a <main> or landmark with aria-label='KYC Verification' so screen readers can navigate to it
When advancing steps, focus must be programmatically moved to the new step heading or the first focusable element to announce the context change
Personal info form fields must each have an associated label via htmlFor; required fields must use required=true on Input
Inline validation errors on Input fields must be announced via aria-describedby + role=alert (built into Input error prop)
FileUpload drop zone must have role=button and keyboard activation (Enter/Space) — confirm this is satisfied by the DS FileUpload component
FileUpload error message (type mismatch, size exceeded) must be surfaced via the error prop so it is announced via role=alert
Accepted file list must include an accessible remove/delete action with aria-label='Remove [filename]'
Selfie step camera trigger button must have aria-label='Take selfie' or equivalent
Selfie image preview must have alt text describing the captured image, e.g. alt='Selfie preview'
Verification status (pending, approved, rejected) must not rely on colour alone — pair Badge variant with explicit status text
Rejected state must include an aria-live=polite or role=alert region to announce the rejection reason
Back and Next buttons must have descriptive aria-label values when context is ambiguous, e.g. aria-label='Back to Personal Info', aria-label='Next: Document Upload'
Next button in loading/submitting state must use loading=true on Button which disables click and renders Spinner — Spinner label should read 'Submitting' or 'Processing'
Spinner on submitting state must have label='Submitting your information' for meaningful announcement
All Icon instances used decoratively (e.g. step icons, status icons) must have aria-hidden=true
Colour contrast for muted helper text must meet WCAG AA (4.5:1) — use --color-muted-foreground only where contrast is sufficient against --color-background
responsive_gaps: Stepper at top must reflow gracefully on small screens (< 375px) — consider truncating step labels to icons only on mobile
Back and Next navigation buttons must have a minimum touch target of 44x44px on mobile
FileUpload drag-and-drop zone must remain usable on touch devices where drag is unavailable — click-to-browse fallback must be prominent
Personal info form fields must stack vertically on mobile; avoid multi-column layouts below md breakpoint
Selfie capture UI must be full-width on mobile to accommodate camera viewfinder
Verification status card must be readable and not overflow on small viewports — avoid fixed widths
Wizard Card padding should reduce from lg to sm on mobile to preserve content space
Bottom navigation button row (Back/Next) must not be obscured by mobile keyboard when form fields are focused — consider sticky positioning or scroll-into-view
recommendations: Use Stepper with steps=[{id:'personal-info', label:'Personal Info'},{id:'document-upload', label:'Document Upload'},{id:'selfie', label:'Selfie'}] and current={activeStepId} and status={stepStatusMap} to render the top step indicator
Use Card with padding='lg' as the container for each wizard step's content area
Use Input with label, required=true, error={fieldError} for all personal info fields (name, DOB, address, etc.)
Use Select with label, options, and onChange for any dropdown personal info fields (e.g. country, document type)
Use FileUpload with accept={['application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png']}, maxSizeMb={10}, multiple={false}, onFiles={handleFiles}, error={uploadError} for the document upload step
Use Button with variant='primary' and loading={isSubmitting} for the Next/Submit action button; loading=true disables click and renders Spinner automatically
Use Button with variant='secondary' and disabled={isFirstStep} for the Back navigation button
Use Spinner with label='Submitting your information' for any full-page async loading overlay during step submission
Use Skeleton with variant='rect' and aria-busy=true on the surrounding container for the initial page load state

Use Badge with variant='warning' and children='Pending Review' for pending status, variant='success' and children='Approved' for approved status, and variant='danger' and children='Rejected' for rejected status
Use Modal with title='Submission Error' and open={hasGlobalError} and onClose={clearError} to surface global API errors non-destructively
Use Icon with name='check' and aria-hidden=true for completed step indicators within the Stepper
Use Icon with name='alert' and aria-hidden=true alongside Badge for the rejected status display
Use IconButton with variant='ghost', icon=<Icon name='x'/>, and aria-label='Remove [filename]' for removing an uploaded file from the accepted file list
